Remu of Beta Qigo comes to the throne bent on a lasting legacy.
Shirpkizpa of Bufumbe secures the line, with Shirpkizpa grown to take the crown.
House Tangumisu of Nihwimotlan and House Wopihpe of Sitomatla were joined in royal marriage.
Chaho of Wekoche comes to the throne bent on the safety of the lordship.
Vispis of Qedleg stops scheming for the house.
Boma conquered Floor 1 (Floor of the Frozen Ridge) using magic (score 14 vs DC 8). Defeated Astra. Promoted to F-Rank!
Wangin survived descent to Layer 1 (Edge of the Abyss), enduring 13 strain damage: Light dizziness and loss of balance upon ascent. Whistle tier: red. Salvaged ancient relic: Sun Stone Shard!
Hunters of Angisiniq share a great whale at Bisha; no family goes hungry this winter.
A league of the landless spreads through the towns of Sitomatla; pamphlets and sermons decry manorial fiefs.
Delvers of Upivug break into a vast geode cavern beyond Upivug; the deep realm grows.
A cave-in thunders through Chotepec; Himopan digs for survivors for weeks.
The tiny Free Union of Sitohi seeks shelter and is peacefully absorbed into Mehnihseneh.
The tiny Republic of Pumdugu seeks shelter and is peacefully absorbed into Pumdugu.
Japna' raises its port toll at Rumnek; the harbour-masters of Hoexia protest.
The Conquest of Pumdugu is known as the Holy Defence among the Dosehelakewu, and as the Heretics' War among the Nole.
Garrisons of Nantun storm the ramparts of Mayduz, driving out the defenders of Sunron and hoisting their triumphant colors.
Following fierce fighting along the fortifications, Porta Khukh surrenders to Qumfogguq; its magistrates swear fealty as Qabiwaqeshu's banner is hauled down.
Feast of Lights: The longest night in Mebi is spent by firelight in Mebi, with stories and gifts.
Saturnalia: The longest night in Madqilia is spent by firelight in Bogentum, with stories and gifts.

The final citadels fall, and the crown of Holy See of Nametakot is broken forever. With treasuries emptied and borders dissolved, Menushe Dipa flees into bitter exile as the lordship fades into legend.
A victor's peace is forged: after 1 year of campaign in the Motadesh Succession War, Motadesh prevail, annexing contested borderlands.
After a bitter siege, the ramparts of Siguvu give way! Vanguard forces of Beta Heqasu storm the royal seat of Pajalara, casting down imperial banners and plundering the state vaults.
The walls of Manzonhara crumble under heavy assault! Cohorts of Nantun breach the defenses of Sunron's capital, scattering the garrison and sacking the palace.
Following fierce fighting along the fortifications, Binranzaki surrenders to Nantun; its magistrates swear fealty as Sunron's banner is hauled down.
Feast of Lights: The longest night in Beta Qigo is spent by firelight in Reda, with stories and gifts.
Citing border encroachments and bitter territorial grievances, Republic of Qedleg mobilizes its hosts against Cybernetic Union of Qabiwaqeshu. Banners unfurl for the Conquest of Qabiwaqeshu.
Neither camp can break the front: envoys sign a mutual cessation of hostilities, ending the War of the Nantun Crown (1 year) in an uneasy truce.
Pujlumvura of Lakngiq takes up the cause of the fortunes of the dynasty.
A perilous interregnum grips Lakngiq following the heirless death of Jikpaksum (battle wounds). Retainers of House Qangsankak storm the assembly and usurp the crown.
Nonkhan of Zhodhin takes up the cause of a lasting legacy.
The bells of Zhodhin toll for the passing of Roryedlop II the Elder Midzok (old age). The youth Nonkhan ascends the throne under a regency council.
Shilo of Shetodi comes to the throne bent on glory.
In the royal halls of Shetodi, Yashi II the Generous Paka breathes their last, succumbing to old age. Shilo ascends the ancestral throne amid solemn acclamation.
Norona of Debre Nasu takes up the cause of the spread of the faith.
Solemn rites echo through Debre Nasu following the death of Rowa the Restorer Winiki (old age). Norona is crowned sovereign before the assembled court.
Yashi of Ditodi takes up the cause of knowledge.
A perilous interregnum grips Ditodi following the heirless death of Shini (a hunting accident). Retainers of House Gotakishebi storm the assembly and usurp the crown.

AGRARIAN REVOLT: Crushed by feudal ichor-tithes and noble exploitation, the laborers of Doputishoma rise in open insurrection! Renouncing the lords of Shetodi, they establish the Workers' Federation of Doputishoma with Dashana leading the commune.
Dashana is acclaimed ruler of Workers' Federation of Doputishoma.
Seeking to restore imperial order by force, Iron Dominion of Shetodi dispatches punitive legions to subdue Workers' Federation of Doputishoma. The bitter Border War of Doputishoma is underway.

REPUBLICAN REVOLT: Weary of monarchical tyranny, the burghers and civic guilds of Hache take up arms for freedom! Seceding from Fesambe, they hoist republican banners beneath Mowi to establish the United Provinces of Chisowapoto.
Mowi is acclaimed ruler of United Provinces of Chisowapoto.
The civic bell of Kikmal tolls as magistrates and clan heads inaugurate the Tribe of Jiqruqvang, establishing its seat of power.
Blight and ash blacken the fields of Mebi; the wards go hollow-eyed and silent.
Bigasha opens the royal granaries of Mebi; bread is carted to every village and the people bless the crown.
Tlacho (Master Artisan) completes a cathedral ceiling fresco celebrating the history of the lordship in Likitleho.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Shadow agents from Siteni divert 25 gold from the tax vaults of Qedleg!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Covert saboteurs from Bimpan detonate powder stores in Pumdugu, gutting frontline regiments!

ARCANE MELTDOWN: Unstable alchemy and runaway leyline containment experiments detonate violently near Arcane Proving Grounds of Cell 365! Magical shockwaves scorch the earth into irradiated ash, collapsing towers and displacing hundreds.
QUEST COMPLETED: Quest for the Sunken Heirloom in Wenrun! Jujriljusa unlocks the sealed adamantine vault, unearthing the sacred relic Iron-bound Coronet of Rate to global acclaim!
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Miprof pave the Miprof-Apinjuaq Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Miprof and Apinjuaq (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Mebi pave the Zebole-Lemohchiti Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Zebole and Lemohchiti (+trade, +stability).
PATRON MIRACLE: Zephyros the Sky-Sovereign hurls deafening thunderbolts across the frontiers of Nantun, scattering hostile vanguards with righteous gales (+15% army power).
RUINOUS GIFT: Pestilax the Rot-Father touches the hosts of Pajalara with blissful pestilence! Rotting flesh feels no pain, turning armies into unyielding revenants (+12% army power, +10 resilience).
ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Shubbog the Brood Mother spawns thousands of chittering dark young in the sacred groves of Lakngiq, swarming forward under black skies (+20% army power, -6 stability).
NATURE BLESSING: Ignis the Hearth Caldera stokes the caldera hearths of Qedleg! Master smiths forge shimmering obsidian weaponry bathed in magma (+16% army power, +15 gold).
Sava, a lone hunter, stalks the beast-infested wards of Ngaviq through three nights of mist and ends it.
A bone-masked seer, Yeka, descends into Hamiso and speaks the names of those who will die before spring.
Unrest of the year: bread riots in Dinotu (Shetodi).

Zhodhin overruns the defensive holdfasts of Pumdugu, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Beta Heqasu.

With swords drawn and ancient pacts invoked, Commune of Motadesh marches against Iron Dominion of Shetodi. The Great Motadesh War begins. Pledging mutual defense, the levies of Nantun rally to Shetodi's side.
Ambition stirs in the courts of Democratic Union of Angisiniq, which openly claims dominion over Trade Federation of Ukatigal. The lordship braces as the Great Angisiniq War erupts.
White banners flutter over the war camps. The Great Angisiniq War ends in mutual exhaustion after less than a year; borders return to former lines.
Tonfon II of Nitoweka takes up the cause of knowledge.

Khaozea of Kuo takes up the cause of the safety of the lordship.

In Tlihpeh, Lala the Mighty Helisano departs this life, succumbing to battle wounds. The child Lala (age 3) is crowned beneath a wary council of regents.

A brief gilded dusk settles over Lipkus: cathedral bells ring clear, the plague wanes and the old glory seems near.

Fast-Breaking Feast: People of Debre Nasu wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Debre Nasu.
A catastrophic blow to Motadesh: legions of Nantun overrun the citadel of Naki, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
Garrisons of Nantun storm the ramparts of Naki, driving out the defenders of Nantun and hoisting their triumphant colors.
Night of Nine Songs: Granaries of Motadesh are opened at Nametakot; the whole town eats until dusk.
Night of Offerings: Families in Sitomatla set out lamps and food for their dead at Hohwih.
After seasons of dread, the pestilence finally burns itself out; survivors emerge from shuttered homes to bury the dead and rebuild.

Old border feuds boil over into open bloodshed: Ashen Court of Majutuq launches a determined invasion into High Realm of Mehnihseneh, igniting the Border War of Mehnihseneh. Pledging mutual defense, the levies of Sohchi rally to Mehnihseneh's side.
The War of Zhodhin reaches its conclusion after 4 years of bloodshed: Zhodhin triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Humbled, Polytechnic League of Beta Heqasu bends the knee and becomes a vassal of Zhodhin, paying yearly tribute.
Beaten back from stubborn ramparts, the invasion stalls. The Great Motadesh War concludes after 1 year as Shetodi & Nantun successfully preserve their independence.
Shilo of Shetodi wins the glory sought in the Great Motadesh War.
ENFORCED REGIME CHANGE: Victorious armies from Shetodi mandate total political reorganization in Motadesh! Overthrowing the vanquished elite, they inaugurate the Grand Marshalate of Motadesh.
White banners flutter over the war camps. The Border War of Mehnihseneh ends in mutual exhaustion after less than a year; borders return to former lines.
Renichi of Beta Heqasu comes to the throne bent on the safety of the lordship.
Mourning envelops Beta Heqasu: Koga the Great Shehine dies of fever. The royal scepter passes to Renichi, an underage youth of 13 years, under the stewardship of high chancellors.
Qusasuru of Ngaviq turns from the old cause toward the safety of the lordship.
In Ngaviq, Qumagusa the Elder Jungimiruti departs this life, succumbing to fever. The child Qusasuru (age 5) is crowned beneath a wary council of regents.
Lea of Kuo takes up the cause of the safety of the lordship.
Dynastic extinction strikes Kuo: Khaozea dies heirless (old age). Amid whispers of poison and sword-drawn councils, House Weukhou claims the vacant crown.
Pimaka (Philosopher) calculates the true circumference of the world from tower shadows in Lusuginga.

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Crowds fill the avenues of Utinulnunaat as a mass uprising topples the throne of Commune of Utinulnunaat! The ancient autocracy is abolished, and Ikapagisa proclaims the sovereign United Provinces of Utinulnunaat!
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Tlihpeh! Tlotetla seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Holy See of Tlihpeh!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Hansaka are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Latlohuacan!

NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Lipkus pave the Lipkus-Kijkus Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Lipkus and Kijkus (+trade, +stability).

The Border War of Yetafesa is known as the Great Reckoning in Bufumbe, and as the Plunder in Yetafesa.
Over the centuries Mebi has worn down on the tongue into Mebe; the older name survives only in the chronicles.
Over the centuries Ukatin has worn down on the tongue into Ukachin; the older name survives only in the chronicles.
Over the centuries Likitleho has worn down on the tongue into Ligitleho; the older name survives only in the chronicles.
Kunkoku overruns the defensive holdfasts of Hean, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Kuo.
The walls of Wehwihetlan crumble under heavy assault! Cohorts of Himopan breach the defenses of Lohyihtohwa's capital, scattering the garrison and sacking the palace.
Return of the Sun: People of Ngaviq wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Ngaviq.
Following fierce fighting along the fortifications, Fuodu surrenders to Kunkoku; its magistrates swear fealty as Kuo's banner is hauled down.
Whale Thanks: Boats of Qukigu are blessed and raced off Qukigu; sailors are toasted ashore.
Day of Drawn Swords: Warriors of Hansaka parade and wrestle in the squares of Hansaka to honour the old victories.
Feast of Lights: The longest night in Qoloqa is spent by firelight in Zebole, with stories and gifts.
Citing border encroachments and bitter territorial grievances, Ashen Court of Majutuq mobilizes its hosts against Grand Marshalate of Bisha. Banners unfurl for the Bisha Campaign.
The Himopan Succession War reaches its conclusion after 3 years of bloodshed: Himopan triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Humbled, Military Junta of Lohyihtohwa bends the knee and becomes a vassal of Himopan, paying yearly tribute.
ENFORCED REGIME CHANGE: Victorious armies from Himopan mandate total political reorganization in Lohyihtohwa! Overthrowing the vanquished elite, they inaugurate the Trade Federation of Lohyihtohwa.
Through stubborn resolve, Ivitat & Beta Heqasu shatter the enemy offensive. The Ivitat Campaign ends after 2 years with the defenders holding firm.
Qusagaqa of Beta Heqasu carries the faith to the unbelievers in the Ivitat Campaign.
Shusha of Yishehagondar turns from the old cause toward glory.
In Yishehagondar, Kemuba the Wary Yawi departs this life, succumbing to a wasting sickness. The child Shusha (age 13) is crowned beneath a wary council of regents.

REPUBLICAN REVOLT: Weary of monarchical tyranny, the burghers and civic guilds of Tedodu take up arms for freedom! Seceding from Lipkus, they hoist republican banners beneath Feloka to establish the Free Commonwealth of Tedodu.
Feloka is acclaimed ruler of Free Commonwealth of Tedodu.
Jaguma (Master Artificer) engineers a revolutionary watermill mechanism that doubles grain milling yields in Pavaniq.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Assassins from Wekoche strike in the dead of night, slaying Mushu in the court of Shetodi!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Gao are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Nashoknagar!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Pajalara are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Tedodu!
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Yishehagondar pave the Hashezegondar-Hasu Maritime Lane, establishing a direct route between Hashezegondar and Hasu (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Yabhodzamin pave the Tedshahr-Senrof Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Tedshahr and Senrof (+trade, +stability).
PATRON MIRACLE: Zephyros the Sky-Sovereign hurls deafening thunderbolts across the frontiers of Zhodhin, scattering hostile vanguards with righteous gales (+15% army power).

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.
